kind: must-be-deep
depth: deep
reason: deep-wrappers
-- base/main.tf --
module "queue" {
  source = "./modules/queue"
  name   = "q"
}
-- base/modules/queue/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name = var.name
}

variable "name" {
  type = string
}
-- base/modules/queue/wrappers/main.tf --
module "wrapper" {
  source   = "../"
  for_each = var.items
  name     = try(each.value.name, "a")
}

variable "items" {
  type = any
}
-- head/main.tf --
module "queue" {
  source = "./modules/queue"
  name   = "q"
}
-- head/modules/queue/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name = var.name
}

variable "name" {
  type = string
}
-- head/modules/queue/wrappers/main.tf --
module "wrapper" {
  source   = "../"
  for_each = var.items
  name     = try(each.value.name, "b")
}

variable "items" {
  type = any
}
